_about: The ElevenLabs-timed variant of the Ep1 v3 stick lock (pass v3-voices-el, phase 2, 2026-09-27). The same chapters as show/reel/ep01-v32/ep01-v32.manifest.json (key ep01-v32-stick), with the six story chapters from show/reel/ep01-v32-el/ep01-v32-el-<seg>.json: the lock's timelines with every line's take swapped for its ElevenLabs set-A take (audio/ep01/v3-el/ep01-v32/<seg>/), the lock's gaps and J-cut leads kept, and beats longer or shorter only by the takes' lengths (tools/el_lock.py). Sound: the lock pass's bed builder (audio/reel/ep01-v32/bed.py) re-run on these timelines (tools/el_bed.py -> audio/reel/ep01-v32-el/<seg>-bed.wav): rooms, the beats' sounds and pads, laid to the new beat times. Notes: show/episodes/ep01/production/full-v3/voices-el.md. Nothing here was watched or heard. Reserved lengths (the Runway frames): S7.13, v31-32.01d keep their length and line starts.
